resources.string: Release • Safer sharing and Search Assistant
• Share a generated search through Android’s system share sheet.
• Medium/High-risk searches must be reviewed before they can be copied or shared.
• The local rating prompt and new sharing screens are available in all six app languages.
Generated searches still never use the | operator; Pokémon GO actions stay manual.
Medium-risk Share and Search Assistant paths were checked on a physical Android device.
The rating prompt stays on-device. No analytics, ads, tracking, or account access were added.
Share a low-risk goal and confirm the Android chooser shows the correct search.
Try a Medium-risk share; cancelling the warning must not open the chooser.
In Search Assistant, hundo should copy 4* directly; shiny should require review first.
